name: The balance of gaining prestige
teaser: A mod to change the prestige requirement as in 1.0 Tarkov but without story quests
description:
Prestige Conditions Override

A server mod for SPT 4.0 that brings prestige requirements closer to the original Escape from Tarkov, but without story quests that are not available in SPT.

UPD 03.06

Creator of the Content Backport mod - Prestige Updated the requirements for prestige according to the same principle as in the standards settings of this mod, now this mod can only be used to create your own balance by changing the file db.json in the mods folder

What this mod does

  • Configures prestige requirements through JSON config:
    • player level
    • rubles amount
    • skill levels
    • hideout area levels
  • Removes selected quests from prestige requirements (blacklist).
  • Overrides prestige quest start conditions (level and, if needed, prestige level).

Why

In vanilla SPT, some prestige requirements rely on quests that are missing or do not fit backport-based setups.
This mod makes progression more consistent and closer to live Tarkov, while keeping configuration flexible for your own balance.

Dependencies

These mods are required to run, it is not known whether they will work on higher versions, but there should be no problems.

versions.description: reduced the error logging to be behind config. MODDERS THAT USE COMMONLIB - ENABLE ITEM DEBUGGING IN THE CONFIG AND FIX YOUR SHIT

• FINALLY fixed salvage zones :prayge:
  • salvage zone UI update + icon!
  • add random craft result amount options
  • initialized buyrestrictioncurrent for traderhelper barters (ty for the detailed bug report!)

  • added fixplugintypesserialization patcher (thank you tarkin ❤️)

• fixed hideout crafts service not supporting anything but arrays /bonk

• Added new helper to slothelper to add ids by name
  • Added fix custom item sort order patch (thanks Pein! ❤ )
  • Added new “Salvage” zones to possible quest types
  • Added locales for the salvage zone interactions
  • Fixed hideout crafts not supporting .jsonc /bonk

• Implemented random loot container support for customitemserviceextended
  • Added save method to confighelper

HOTFIX NUMBER 2 FOR THE DAY REEEEEEE

  • fixed caliberhelper from being completely broken. PLEASE DOWNLOAD THIS VERSION IF YOU UPDATED TODAY.
• fixed questhelper adding to empty weapon conditions (specifically a punisher part 4 issue)

• added weapon mod quest helper method
  • added CustomDialogueService for custom NPC Dialogues

  • fixed custom modslot images becoming blurry on low texture settings (Thanks Pein!)
added helper method for dogtag quests

• added questhelper
  • force image cache if using fika because of local headless skill issue

Fixed Fika loading issue with icons!

  • added new ImageManager that works similar to spt’s BundleManager, creating a cache of icons and textures if needed

dependencies.name: WTT - Content Backport
dependencies.teaser: The moment you've all been waiting for....

versions.description:
MAJOR UPDATE - REQUIRES LATEST COMMONLIB 2.0.22

  • added all missing items and clothing up to 7/25/2026 (NOTE: SOME THINGS WERE OMITTED LIKE NOTES, TAPES, RECORDER, ETC). If these items were omitted their bundles are still present if someone needs them for a personal project.
  • tons of bug fixes, too many to count
  • added patch to fence plate randomization to fix the weird logic (will be removed in 4.1)

HOTFIX

  • changed slothelper methods to ensure the slot exists before pushing to it
  • stopped overriding the twitch case entirely and safely added the new streamer items
  • val 4 sounds have been updated to their new sounds

• fixed arctika outfit bundles missing from bundles.json /bonk
  • fixed the spear handguard mod_tactical to properly add the new slot
  • added missing locales for a bunch of customizations /bonk
  • changed blacklist over from being hardcoded to being a new property in the item .jsons, you can now un-blacklist items straight from their config by setting "addtoItemBlacklist": False
  • removed items from spawning in wooden ammo crates and the mira ave flare body…. /bonk
  • blacklisted several more items that were spamming pmc loot, namely posters and….. DUCKS.

MAJOR BUGFIXES + ADDITIONS! NEW MAIN MENUS BACKPORTED! MANNEQUIN POSES + NEW CLOTHING!

  • fixed m4 grips
  • fixed p226 anims
  • fixed locale spam
  • fixed m110 animations
  • fixed audiobanks for multiple weapons
  • fixed bad clones for a few items
  • pushed new flash hider to all aks
  • fixed a TON of animations
  • fixed a TON of cubemap issues (RIP Eco’s sanity 😭)
  • fixed the m590 and r970 pistol grip anims
  • added a new patcher for new main menu backgrounds
  • added all four ending backgrounds and prestige background
  • added new items since the last patch, including duckov items
  • added new mannequin poses from preorder and prestige
  • disabled black division nods and armbands by adding them to blacklist

• added missing bundles for new reworked anim weapons + ana m2
  • fixed TKPD sound issue

• (hopefully) fixed issues with m4 sounds causing looping sounds & FIKA extract bug
  • updated CN locales

MAJOR bugfix number 2! REQUIRES LATEST COMMONLIB 2.0.11

  • rebuilt g36 container for new front sight bone, added it properly for the new front sight
  • added vpo barrel to modslots
  • rebuilt and added new animations for m590
  • rebuilt and added new animations for r870
  • rebuilt and added new animations for p226
  • added RU locale, updated CN locale
  • fixed incorrect sounds for some of the M4 weapons
  • fixed MXLR not working on tarkov shooter part 2
  • fixed zraichy achievement working on any target lul
  • fixed neosteel mandibles not going into helmet
  • updated all 4 menpo mask conflicting items
  • fixed TT AP ammo
  • fixed sr-25 Taupe preset
  • fixed ANA M2 preset
  • fixed jaypc preset
  • fixed JPC black and multicam presets
  • fixed alpine caiman preset
  • fixed alpine ulach preset
  • added m53a1 gasmask to decontamination services quest
  • fixed incorrect 6b45 general flea price
  • added new 6sh112 bundle
  • removed TONS of weapon parts from appearing in toolboxes and ammo crates
  • added new dogtags to quests

Major bugfixes! REQUIRES LATEST COMMONLIB 2.0.9

  • fixed commando codes, they now give items through the System
  • fixed headphones not going into the character
  • fixed m16 assort locale
  • fixed small containers not being able to go in secure filters
  • fixed bad hands path on the two newest outfits
  • fixed tig splint missing dependencies
  • fixed dogtags not being able to go into dogtag/sicc container
  • updated m110 stock (thanks Eco!)
  • updated g36 bundle to have the new front sight bone (thanks Eco!)
  • fixed TONS of filter issues (thanks EpicRangeTime!)
  • added some extra locales for an upcoming addon 😉
  • added Chinese Localization (thanks AkameKaga!)
  • fixed fika loading issue (fixed with latest commonlib 2.0.9) getting hung up on icons

and probably more i’m forgetting. Thank you to everyone who reported bugs!
